verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a hosted email service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of any telemetry setting or tracking opt-out. One community comment praises Fastmail for being up front about data handling, but that is general transparency, not an opt-out capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
